subject: Next step: Private deployment technical deep-dive and architecture review
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Natalie Park <natalie.park@healthcore.com>, Tom Nguyen <t.nguyen@healthcore.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 16:15:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & proposed architecture review for Private deployment

Hi Natalie / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call: HealthCore is evaluating a Private (VPC) deployment for PHI workloads, prioritized by predictable latency, strict network controls, and SOC2-aligned auditability. You flagged three hard requirements: customer-managed KMS, VPC peering with your analytics VNet, and a documented retention policy for audit logs.

Next step proposal: schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive / architecture review with our solutions engineering and security SMEs to walk through a reference VPC topology, KMS integration patterns, and deployment options for an on-prem appliance vs. customer-managed cloud VPC. Suggested agenda:
- 10m: introductions + goals
- 20m: proposed VPC topology and storage/KMS options
- 20m: security controls, logging, and compliance artifacts
- 10m: next steps / timelines

Proposed times (all PST):
1) Mon Feb 23, 10:00–11:00
2) Tue Feb 24, 14:00–15:00
3) Wed Feb 25, 09:00–10:00

If none of these work, send a couple preferred slots and we’ll align. Please let me know who from your side should join (network/infra, security, procurement) and if you want us to include an attendee from our on-prem engineering team for deployment-level questions.

Attaching the discovery notes and a first-pass network diagram for context.

Attachments: 20260220-discovery-notes.pdf, network-diagram_v1.png, redwood-private-overview.pdf

Thanks — look forward to getting this scheduled.

Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0114

Thanks Natalie — Tue Feb 24 14:00–15:00 PST works for us. I’ll send a calendar invite in a separate email.

Pre-read items I’m attaching and linking below:
- discovery notes (short version) — 20260220-discovery-notes.pdf
- reference VPC topology + CIDR examples — network-diagram_v1.png
- Redwood Private one-pager (KMS / control plane model) — redwood-private-overview.pdf

Short answer on temporary access patterns for the control plane: our private deployment model supports either (A) customer-managed peering with a small control-plane CIDR (recommended: single /28 per region) and explicit IP allowlist, or (B) a relay over a mutually-authenticated TLS connection for air-gapped environments. For the call, Vivek (CC’d) will outline the pros/cons for both patterns and bring concrete CIDR examples.

Vivek — can you prepare a slide with the two connectivity patterns and the KMS integration checklist? Monica — can you bring the SOC2 artifacts and sample audit-log retention policy so Natalie’s security team can sanity-check?

I’ll follow up momentarily with the invite.

Cheers,
Alex
